description: tools/test-projects/mesh-raycast (BUILD_TYPE=Release WEB_PROJECT=mesh-raycast tools/build.sh web: the budgets are release figures): S26's MeshRaycast in a build without pthreads (WebAssembly, the scalar slab test): 10,000 rays against 1,000 spheres of about 1,000 triangles, p99 at most 4 ms (R28, AC17); then spatial-queries AC15: 10,000 Lua Physics.overlapSphereNonAlloc calls on 2,000 bodies and 10,000 MeshRaycast.overlapSphere calls, p99 per call at most 0.04 ms each. No pixel check.
